tableQuery.query:
with delivery_quarter_rst as (
    select distinct 
        seasonal1_cd
    from (
        select seasonal1_cd from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_calendar 
        where calendar_date >=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间]
        and calendar_date <=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
        union all
        select seasonal1_cd from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_calendar
        where calendar_date=today()
    ) t
)
select
    t1.presale_type                 as `预售类型`
	,t1.statis_tm_type              as `时间类型`
    ,t1.statis_date                 as `日`
    ,t1.statis_week                 as `周`
    ,t1.statis_weekday              as `星期几`
    ,t1.statis_mon                  as `月`
    ,t1.statis_quarter              as `季`
    ,t1.statis_year                 as `年`
	,t2.channel_brand_code          as `渠道品牌编码`
	,t2.channel_brand               as `渠道品牌`
	,t2.brand_large_area            as `品牌大区`
    ,t2.region_code                 as `区域编码`
	,t2.region                      as `区域`
	,t1.cms_code                    as `店铺编码`
	,t2.store_name                  as `店铺名称`
	,t2.store_type_cd               as `店铺类型代码`
	,t2.store_type_name             as `店铺类型名称`
	,t2.store_type_dtl              as `店铺类型明细`
	,t2.open_store_dt               as `开店日期`
	,t2.close_store_dt              as `闭店日期`
	,t3.good_brand_code             as `商品品牌编码`
	,t3.good_brand                  as `商品品牌`
	,t3.big_class                   as `大类`
	,t3.mid_class                   as `中类`
	,t3.small_class                 as `小类`
	,t3.prop                        as `属性`
	,t3.top_bottom                  as `上下装`
	,t3.biz_type                    as `业务类型`
	,t3.imc_type                    as `IMC类型`
	,t3.series                      as `主题`
	,t3.sub_series                  as `故事包`
	,t3.prd_year                    as `产品年`
	,t3.prd_quarter                 as `产品季`
	,t3.prd_year_quarter            as `产品年季`
    ,t3.sale_channel_txt	        as `渠道货品`
	,t3.delivery_quarter            as `配货季`
	,t3.fashion_num                 as `款号`
	,t1.art_no                      as `货号`
	,t3.good_name                   as `商品名称`
	,t3.ipo_dt                      as `上市日期`
	,t1.color_cd                    as `颜色编码`
	,t1.color                       as `颜色`
	,t3.prd_line                    as `系列`
	,t3.tag_price                   as `吊牌价`
    ,case when t3.delivery_quarter in (select seasonal1_cd from delivery_quarter_rst) or t3.delivery_quarter='CO' then '期货'
	      else '旧货' end                               as `期旧货`
	,sum(bq_retail_amt)             as `本期零售金额`
    ,sum(bq_retail_qty)             as `本期零售数量`
    ,sum(bq_retail_tag_amt)         as `本期零售吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_sale_singl_amt)         as `本期销售单金额`
    ,sum(bq_sale_singl_qty)         as `本期销售单数量`
	,sum(bq_sale_singl_tag_amt)		as `本期销售单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_chg_singl_amt)          as `本期换货单金额`
    ,sum(bq_chg_singl_qty)          as `本期换货单数量`
	,sum(bq_chg_singl_tag_amt)		as `本期换货单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_ret_doc_amt)            as `本期退单金额`
    ,sum(bq_ret_doc_qty)            as `本期退单数量`
	,sum(bq_ret_doc_tag_amt)		as `本期退单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_order_qty)              as `本期订单数量`
	,sum(tq_retail_amt)             as `同期零售金额`
    ,sum(tq_retail_qty)             as `同期零售数量`
    ,sum(tq_retail_tag_amt)         as `同期零售吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_sale_singl_amt)         as `同期销售单金额`
    ,sum(tq_sale_singl_qty)         as `同期销售单数量`
	,sum(tq_sale_singl_tag_amt)		as `同期销售单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_chg_singl_amt)          as `同期换货单金额`
    ,sum(tq_chg_singl_qty)          as `同期换货单数量`
	,sum(tq_chg_singl_tag_amt)		as `同期换货单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_ret_doc_amt)            as `同期退单金额`
    ,sum(tq_ret_doc_qty)            as `同期退单数量`
	,sum(tq_ret_doc_tag_amt)		as `同期退单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_order_qty)              as `同期订单数量`
	,ifnull(sum(ys_target),0)       as `预算目标`
	,ifnull(sum(dp_target),0)       as `吊牌目标`
    ,case when sum(bq_retail_tag_amt)=0 then 0 else sum(bq_retail_amt)/sum(bq_retail_tag_amt) end as `商品折扣`
	,author_id                      as `达人ID`
	,author_name                    as `达人名称`
	,compass_source_content_type    as `流量体载`
	,case when t1.cms_code like 'DY_MAIA%' and  (author_id is null or author_id='') and (author_name is null or author_name='') 
          and (compass_source_content_type in ('其他','商品卡')or compass_source_content_type is null or compass_source_content_type='')
    then '自播'else dr_type         end `达人类型`
from (
    --本期
    select
        presale_type
    	,statis_tm_type
    	,statis_date
    	,statis_week
        ,statis_weekday
        ,statis_mon
        ,statis_quarter
        ,statis_year
    	,cms_code
        ,art_no
        ,color_cd
        ,color
		,author_id
		,author_name
		,compass_source_content_type
		,dr_type
        ,retail_amt              as bq_retail_amt
        ,retail_qty              as bq_retail_qty
        ,retail_tag_amt          as bq_retail_tag_amt
        ,sale_singl_amt          as bq_sale_singl_amt
        ,sale_singl_qty          as bq_sale_singl_qty
		,sale_singl_tag_amt      as bq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,chg_singl_amt           as bq_chg_singl_amt
        ,chg_singl_qty           as bq_chg_singl_qty
		,chg_singl_tag_amt		 as bq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,ret_doc_amt             as bq_ret_doc_amt
        ,ret_doc_qty             as bq_ret_doc_qty
		,ret_doc_tag_amt		 as bq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,order_qty               as bq_order_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_amt
        ,0 as tq_retail_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as tq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_order_qty
    	,0 as ys_target
		,0 as dp_target
    
    from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_ebi_order_sale_sku_mi
    where statis_date>=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间]
    and statis_date<=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
    and statis_tm_type= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_日期类型（线上订单）] 
    
    union all
    --同期
    select
        presale_type
    	,statis_tm_type
    	,statis_date
    	,statis_week
        ,statis_weekday
        ,statis_mon
        ,statis_quarter
        ,statis_year
    	,cms_code
        ,art_no
        ,color_cd
        ,color
		,author_id
		,author_name
		,compass_source_content_type
		,dr_type
        ,0 as bq_retail_amt
        ,0 as bq_retail_qty
        ,0 as bq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as bq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_order_qty
        ,retail_amt              as tq_retail_amt
        ,retail_qty              as tq_retail_qty
        ,retail_tag_amt          as tq_retail_tag_amt
        ,sale_singl_amt          as tq_sale_singl_amt
        ,sale_singl_qty          as tq_sale_singl_qty
		,sale_singl_tag_amt      as tq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,chg_singl_amt           as tq_chg_singl_amt
        ,chg_singl_qty           as tq_chg_singl_qty
		,chg_singl_tag_amt		 as tq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,ret_doc_amt             as tq_ret_doc_amt
        ,ret_doc_qty             as tq_ret_doc_qty
		,ret_doc_tag_amt		 as tq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,order_qty               as tq_order_qty
    	,0 as ys_target
		,0 as dp_target
    
    from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_ebi_order_sale_sku_mi
    where statis_date>=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期开始时间]
    and statis_date<=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期结束时间]
    and statis_tm_type= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_日期类型（线上订单）] 
    
    union all
    --预算目标
    SELECT
        '' as presale_type
    	,[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_日期类型（线上订单）]  as statis_tm_type
    	,toDate(t1.sale_dt) as statis_date
        ,t2.yyyyww as statis_week
        ,t2.weekday as statis_weekday
        ,substr(toString(t1.sale_dt),1,7) as statis_mon
        ,t2.curr_quarter as statis_quarter
        ,t2.yyyy as statis_year
        ,t1.store_code	AS cms_code
    	,'' as art_no
    	,'' as color_cd
    	,'' as color
		,'' as author_id
		,'' as author_name
		,'' as compass_source_content_type
		,'' as dr_type
        ,0 as bq_retail_amt
        ,0 as bq_retail_qty
        ,0 as bq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as bq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_order_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_amt
        ,0 as tq_retail_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as tq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_order_qty
    	,t1.cw_ls_target as ys_target
		,t1.zk_ls_target as dp_target
    
    FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_target_df t1
	left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_calendar t2
	on toDate(t1.sale_dt)=t2.calendar_date
    WHERE sale_dt >= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间] 
    AND sale_dt <= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
) t1
left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_store_info_df t2
on t1.cms_code=t2.cms_code
left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_good_art_no_df t3
on t1.art_no=t3.art_no
where t2.brand_large_area='线上'
group by t1.presale_type
	,t1.statis_tm_type
    ,t1.statis_date
    ,t1.statis_week
    ,t1.statis_weekday
    ,t1.statis_mon
    ,t1.statis_quarter
    ,t1.statis_year
	,t2.channel_brand_code
	,t2.channel_brand
	,t2.brand_large_area
    ,t2.region_code
	,t2.region
	,t1.cms_code
	,t2.store_name
	,t2.store_type_cd
	,t2.store_type_name
	,t2.store_type_dtl
	,t2.open_store_dt
	,t2.close_store_dt
	,t3.good_brand_code
	,t3.good_brand
	,t3.big_class
	,t3.mid_class
	,t3.small_class
	,t3.prop
	,t3.top_bottom
	,t3.biz_type
	,t3.imc_type
	,t3.series
	,t3.sub_series
	,t3.prd_year
	,t3.prd_quarter
	,t3.prd_year_quarter
    ,t3.sale_channel_txt	     
	,t3.delivery_quarter
	,t3.fashion_num
	,t1.art_no
	,t3.good_name
	,t3.ipo_dt
	,t1.color_cd
	,t1.color
	,t3.prd_line
	,t3.tag_price
	,t1.author_id
	,t1.author_name
	,t1.compass_source_content_type
	,t1.dr_type

else cast(SUM([本期退单金额]) as Double)/cast(SUM([本期销售单金额])+SUM([本期换货单金额]) as Double)=0
end

when cast(SUM([本期销售单数量])+SUM([本期换货单数量]) as Double)=0 then 0

end

metric.name: 本期预算目标达成率

end

tableQuery.query:
with delivery_quarter_rst as (
    select distinct 
        seasonal1_cd
    from (
        select seasonal1_cd from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_calendar 
        where calendar_date >=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间]
        and calendar_date <=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
        union all
        select seasonal1_cd from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_calendar
        where calendar_date=today()
    ) t
)
select
    t1.presale_type                 as `预售类型`
	,t1.statis_tm_type              as `时间类型`
    ,t1.statis_date                 as `日`
    ,t1.statis_week                 as `周`
    ,t1.statis_weekday              as `星期几`
    ,t1.statis_mon                  as `月`
    ,t1.statis_quarter              as `季`
    ,t1.statis_year                 as `年`
	,t2.channel_brand_code          as `渠道品牌编码`
	,t2.channel_brand               as `渠道品牌`
	,t2.brand_large_area            as `品牌大区`
    ,t2.region_code                 as `区域编码`
	,t2.region                      as `区域`
	,t1.cms_code                    as `店铺编码`
	,t2.store_name                  as `店铺名称`
	,t2.store_type_cd               as `店铺类型代码`
	,t2.store_type_name             as `店铺类型名称`
	,t2.store_type_dtl              as `店铺类型明细`
	,t2.open_store_dt               as `开店日期`
	,t2.close_store_dt              as `闭店日期`
	,t3.good_brand_code             as `商品品牌编码`
	,t3.good_brand                  as `商品品牌`
	,t3.big_class                   as `大类`
	,t3.mid_class                   as `中类`
	,t3.small_class                 as `小类`
	,t3.prop                        as `属性`
	,t3.top_bottom                  as `上下装`
	,t3.biz_type                    as `业务类型`
	,t3.imc_type                    as `IMC类型`
	,t3.series                      as `主题`
	,t3.sub_series                  as `故事包`
	,t3.prd_year                    as `产品年`
	,t3.prd_quarter                 as `产品季`
	,t3.prd_year_quarter            as `产品年季`
    ,t3.sale_channel_txt	        as `渠道货品`
	,t3.delivery_quarter            as `配货季`
	,t3.fashion_num                 as `款号`
	,t1.art_no                      as `货号`
	,t3.good_name                   as `商品名称`
	,t3.ipo_dt                      as `上市日期`
	,t1.color_cd                    as `颜色编码`
	,t1.color                       as `颜色`
	,t3.prd_line                    as `系列`
	,t3.tag_price                   as `吊牌价`
    ,case when t3.delivery_quarter in (select seasonal1_cd from delivery_quarter_rst) or t3.delivery_quarter='CO' then '期货'
	      else '旧货' end                               as `期旧货`
	,sum(bq_retail_amt)             as `本期零售金额`
    ,sum(bq_retail_qty)             as `本期零售数量`
    ,sum(bq_retail_tag_amt)         as `本期零售吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_sale_singl_amt)         as `本期销售单金额`
    ,sum(bq_sale_singl_qty)         as `本期销售单数量`
	,sum(bq_sale_singl_tag_amt)		as `本期销售单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_chg_singl_amt)          as `本期换货单金额`
    ,sum(bq_chg_singl_qty)          as `本期换货单数量`
	,sum(bq_chg_singl_tag_amt)		as `本期换货单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_ret_doc_amt)            as `本期退单金额`
    ,sum(bq_ret_doc_qty)            as `本期退单数量`
	,sum(bq_ret_doc_tag_amt)		as `本期退单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(bq_order_qty)              as `本期订单数量`
	,sum(tq_retail_amt)             as `同期零售金额`
    ,sum(tq_retail_qty)             as `同期零售数量`
    ,sum(tq_retail_tag_amt)         as `同期零售吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_sale_singl_amt)         as `同期销售单金额`
    ,sum(tq_sale_singl_qty)         as `同期销售单数量`
	,sum(tq_sale_singl_tag_amt)		as `同期销售单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_chg_singl_amt)          as `同期换货单金额`
    ,sum(tq_chg_singl_qty)          as `同期换货单数量`
	,sum(tq_chg_singl_tag_amt)		as `同期换货单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_ret_doc_amt)            as `同期退单金额`
    ,sum(tq_ret_doc_qty)            as `同期退单数量`
	,sum(tq_ret_doc_tag_amt)		as `同期退单吊牌金额`
    ,sum(tq_order_qty)              as `同期订单数量`
	,ifnull(sum(ys_target),0)       as `预算目标`
	,ifnull(sum(dp_target),0)       as `吊牌目标`
    ,case when sum(bq_retail_tag_amt)=0 then 0 else sum(bq_retail_amt)/sum(bq_retail_tag_amt) end as `商品折扣`
	,author_id                      as `达人ID`
	,author_name                    as `达人名称`
	,compass_source_content_type    as `流量体载`
	,case when t1.cms_code like 'DY_MAIA%' and  (author_id is null or author_id='') and (author_name is null or author_name='') 
          and (compass_source_content_type in ('其他','商品卡')or compass_source_content_type is null or compass_source_content_type='')
    then '自播'else dr_type         end `达人类型`
from (
    --本期
    select
        presale_type
    	,statis_tm_type
    	,statis_date
    	,statis_week
        ,statis_weekday
        ,statis_mon
        ,statis_quarter
        ,statis_year
    	,cms_code
        ,art_no
        ,color_cd
        ,color
		,author_id
		,author_name
		,compass_source_content_type
		,dr_type
        ,retail_amt              as bq_retail_amt
        ,retail_qty              as bq_retail_qty
        ,retail_tag_amt          as bq_retail_tag_amt
        ,sale_singl_amt          as bq_sale_singl_amt
        ,sale_singl_qty          as bq_sale_singl_qty
		,sale_singl_tag_amt      as bq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,chg_singl_amt           as bq_chg_singl_amt
        ,chg_singl_qty           as bq_chg_singl_qty
		,chg_singl_tag_amt		 as bq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,ret_doc_amt             as bq_ret_doc_amt
        ,ret_doc_qty             as bq_ret_doc_qty
		,ret_doc_tag_amt		 as bq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,order_qty               as bq_order_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_amt
        ,0 as tq_retail_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as tq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_order_qty
    	,0 as ys_target
		,0 as dp_target
    
    from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_ebi_order_sale_sku_mi
    where statis_date>=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间]
    and statis_date<=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
    and statis_tm_type= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_日期类型（线上订单）] 
    
    union all
    --同期
    select
        presale_type
    	,statis_tm_type
    	,statis_date
    	,statis_week
        ,statis_weekday
        ,statis_mon
        ,statis_quarter
        ,statis_year
    	,cms_code
        ,art_no
        ,color_cd
        ,color
		,author_id
		,author_name
		,compass_source_content_type
		,dr_type
        ,0 as bq_retail_amt
        ,0 as bq_retail_qty
        ,0 as bq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as bq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_order_qty
        ,retail_amt              as tq_retail_amt
        ,retail_qty              as tq_retail_qty
        ,retail_tag_amt          as tq_retail_tag_amt
        ,sale_singl_amt          as tq_sale_singl_amt
        ,sale_singl_qty          as tq_sale_singl_qty
		,sale_singl_tag_amt      as tq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,chg_singl_amt           as tq_chg_singl_amt
        ,chg_singl_qty           as tq_chg_singl_qty
		,chg_singl_tag_amt		 as tq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,ret_doc_amt             as tq_ret_doc_amt
        ,ret_doc_qty             as tq_ret_doc_qty
		,ret_doc_tag_amt		 as tq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,order_qty               as tq_order_qty
    	,0 as ys_target
		,0 as dp_target
    
    from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_ebi_order_sale_sku_mi
    where statis_date>=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期开始时间]
    and statis_date<=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期结束时间]
    and statis_tm_type= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_日期类型（线上订单）] 
    
    union all
    --预算目标
    SELECT
        '' as presale_type
    	,[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_日期类型（线上订单）]  as statis_tm_type
    	,toDate(t1.sale_dt) as statis_date
        ,t2.yyyyww as statis_week
        ,t2.weekday as statis_weekday
        ,substr(toString(t1.sale_dt),1,7) as statis_mon
        ,t2.curr_quarter as statis_quarter
        ,t2.yyyy as statis_year
        ,t1.store_code	AS cms_code
    	,'' as art_no
    	,'' as color_cd
    	,'' as color
		,'' as author_id
		,'' as author_name
		,'' as compass_source_content_type
		,'' as dr_type
        ,0 as bq_retail_amt
        ,0 as bq_retail_qty
        ,0 as bq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as bq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as bq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as bq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as bq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as bq_order_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_amt
        ,0 as tq_retail_qty
        ,0 as tq_retail_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_sale_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_sale_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_amt
        ,0 as tq_chg_singl_qty
		,0 as tq_chg_singl_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_amt
        ,0 as tq_ret_doc_qty
		,0 as tq_ret_doc_tag_amt
        ,0 as tq_order_qty
    	,t1.cw_ls_target as ys_target
		,t1.zk_ls_target as dp_target
    
    FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_target_df t1
	left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_calendar t2
	on toDate(t1.sale_dt)=t2.calendar_date
    WHERE sale_dt >= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间] 
    AND sale_dt <= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
) t1
left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_store_info_df t2
on t1.cms_code=t2.cms_code
left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_good_art_no_df t3
on t1.art_no=t3.art_no
where t2.brand_large_area='线上'
group by t1.presale_type
	,t1.statis_tm_type
    ,t1.statis_date
    ,t1.statis_week
    ,t1.statis_weekday
    ,t1.statis_mon
    ,t1.statis_quarter
    ,t1.statis_year
	,t2.channel_brand_code
	,t2.channel_brand
	,t2.brand_large_area
    ,t2.region_code
	,t2.region
	,t1.cms_code
	,t2.store_name
	,t2.store_type_cd
	,t2.store_type_name
	,t2.store_type_dtl
	,t2.open_store_dt
	,t2.close_store_dt
	,t3.good_brand_code
	,t3.good_brand
	,t3.big_class
	,t3.mid_class
	,t3.small_class
	,t3.prop
	,t3.top_bottom
	,t3.biz_type
	,t3.imc_type
	,t3.series
	,t3.sub_series
	,t3.prd_year
	,t3.prd_quarter
	,t3.prd_year_quarter
